seed: Title pages and name cards are picture tiles on the Library's Catalog, under Title Pages and Name Cards headers, the way the title mock drags a lower third out of the Library (video-title-wt.html, step 10). At Next defaults with no flag set: the shelf is opened by View > Library and the Catalog segment pressed by the pointer. The Film Super tile is picked up by the pointer, and the Keynote Section tile double clicked by the pointer lands at the playhead on its own track, exactly as Sequence > Insert does. Then Behind Glass, the page made of the recording under it, held over the recording on V1 says it goes on a new track, never into the recording, and let go it lands there half a second in; held over that new track after itself it lands on the same track. Last, in the dock those drops crowded, Keynote Section double clicked by the pointer still lands, the dock at its end shows a whole row of title tiles, and the Media shelf still brings its tile into reach.

steps.comment: View > Library, the way a person turns the shelf on, then the Catalog segment by the pointer.

steps.note: THE FIRST TEST: the Components shelf of a screen recording opens with a Titles group: a picture tile for each title page and name card, each the preset itself on the recording's frame shape, with its kind on the line under its name

steps.comment: The search reads the line under each name, so typing a kind finds every preset of it.

steps.note: Typing name card into the Library's search box leaves the four name cards (and any of your own): Bar, Clean, Accent, Minimal, each pictured where it sits on the frame, at the bottom left

THE SECOND TEST: a double click on the Keynote Section tile, by the pointer, put the Keynote Section title page at the playhead (two seconds) on a track of its own, four seconds long, exactly as Sequence > Insert Title Page > Keynote Section does

steps.comment: The title's headline is picked and its rows open inside the timeline, under the title's track, so the recording on V1 is below the timeline's foot. A turn of the wheel over the timeline brings it up, the way a person reaches it.
Behind Glass now sits under More Styles below the ten calm pages, so it is found by name, as a person would.

steps.note: THE THIRD TEST: the Behind Glass tile held over the recording on V1, half a second in. The lane draws the dashed ghost a file draws, four seconds long, and it says Title Page on a new track: Behind Glass is made of the recording under it, so it is laid over the recording, never cut into it (any other title page goes into V1 in front of the clip there: insert-a-title-before-a-clip-walk)

Let go, the Behind Glass title page lands half a second in on a new track called Title 2, named the way the mock names a title track, under the Keynote Section one on Title, over the recording, which is untouched on V1
THE FOURTH TEST: held over the Title 2 track where it is free, after the first Behind Glass, the ghost says Title 2 and the second lands there at five and a half seconds, on the same track
One Command Z takes the last drop back whole

steps.comment: THE FIFTH TEST, in the dock the drops crowded (Time, Captions and Transitions open over the Library, the shelf's floor binding), with the last drop's headline still picked: a double click on Keynote Section by the pointer. The first click lets go of the headline and its rows fold out of the timeline, and the timeline keeps its height while the tile is picked, so the tile stays under the second click (the press fails if it slides). The press scrolls the dock itself until the tile is whole, the way a person would; with the shelf showing a 3 point sliver above the dock's edge it used to turn the shelf instead, back and forth, and give up.

steps.note: THE FIFTH TEST: with the timeline grown and the dock crowded, a double click on Keynote Section by the pointer still lands it at the playhead, and the dock scrolled to its end shows a whole row of title tiles with a sliver of the next under the fade

steps.comment: Back to the top of the dock, so the Media tile has to be scrolled to the same way Keynote Section was.

steps.note: The Media shelf in the same crowded dock still brings its tile into reach
